scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w packages/rules && npm run dev -w apps/server
scripts.dev:all: npm run build -w packages/rules && npm run dev -w apps/server & npm run dev -w apps/client
scripts.host:lan: npm run build && npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/rules && npm run build -w apps/client && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/rules && npm run test -w packages/rules
scripts.quality: npm run test && npm run typecheck
scripts.quality:ci: npm run quality && npm run test:server:health
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/rules && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/client && npm run lint -w apps/server
